name: Create Hotel

overview.en: [excited] Let's create a Hotel! Think of this... as adding a new customer. [friendly] We need their contact info, tax IDs, addresses, and key people. Once they're in, we can start billing and ordering. Let's do it!
overview.hi: [excited] चलिए एक Hotel बनाते हैं! इसे... एक नया customer add करने की तरह सोचिए। [friendly] हमें उनकी contact info, tax IDs, addresses, और key लोगों की जरूरत है। एक बार वो system में आ गए, तो हम billing और ordering शुरू कर सकते हैं। चलते हैं!

nodes.label: Hotel Name

explanation.en: [casual] First, the Hotel Name. Use the OFFICIAL business name... it shows up on all invoices and orders.
explanation.hi: [casual] सबसे पहले, Hotel Name। OFFICIAL business name use करें... यह सभी invoices और orders पर दिखता है।

nodes.tips: Use the full official name. You can always search by partial name later.

commonQuestions.question: Can I change the name later?
commonQuestions.answer: Yes, you can edit the hotel details after creation.

explanation.en: [casual] What's their primary phone number? We use this for delivery coordination.
explanation.hi: [casual] उनका primary phone number क्या है? हम इसे delivery coordination के लिए use करते हैं।

nodes.label: Contact Email

explanation.en: [casual] And their main email. Invoices and confirmations go right HERE.
explanation.hi: [casual] और उनका main email। Invoices और confirmations सीधे यहीं जाते हैं।

nodes.tips: Use a generic department email rather than a personal one, so it stays active even if staff changes.

nodes.label: Status

explanation.en: [curious] Are they ACTIVE? Only active hotels show up for new orders. Set it to INACTIVE if you stop working with them.
explanation.hi: [curious] क्या वो ACTIVE हैं? नए orders के लिए सिर्फ active hotels ही दिखते हैं। अगर उनके साथ काम बंद हो जाए तो INACTIVE set करें।

nodes.tips: New hotels should always be Active. Use Inactive only when the relationship has ended.

commonQuestions.question: What happens if I set a hotel to Inactive?
commonQuestions.answer: Existing orders and data are preserved, but you cannot create new orders for this hotel. It will not appear in the customer dropdown.

nodes.label: Customer Type

explanation.en: [casual] What type of customer is this? Hotel, hospital, resort... this affects billing rules and agreements.
explanation.hi: [casual] यह किस type का customer है? Hotel, hospital, resort... यह billing rules और agreements को affect करता है।

nodes.tips: Choose the type that best matches the business. This affects which product agreements are available.

nodes.label: GSTIN Number

explanation.en: [curious] Got their GSTIN? This 15-character code is a MUST for tax compliance and invoices.
explanation.hi: [curious] उनका GSTIN मिला? यह 15-character code tax compliance और invoices के लिए जरूरी है।

nodes.tips: Verify the GSTIN on the government GST portal before entering. An incorrect GSTIN will cause invoice mismatches.

commonQuestions.question: Is GSTIN mandatory?
commonQuestions.answer: It depends on your tax configuration. If your business is GST-registered, you should enter the customer's GSTIN for proper invoicing.

explanation.en: [casual] And their PAN number. It's a 10-character code... usually the first part of the GSTIN.
explanation.hi: [casual] और उनका PAN number। यह एक 10-character code है... आमतौर पर GSTIN का पहला हिस्सा होता है।

explanation.en: [casual] Now the billing address. This goes on all financial records.
explanation.hi: [casual] अब billing address। यह सभी financial records पर जाता है।

explanation.en: [casual] Add the area or landmark in line two.
explanation.hi: [casual] Line two में area या landmark add करें।

explanation.en: [casual] The city.
explanation.hi: [casual] शहर का नाम।

nodes.label: State

explanation.en: [curious] The state. This is IMPORTANT... it affects the GST calculation for interstate deliveries!
explanation.hi: [curious] State। यह IMPORTANT है... यह interstate deliveries के लिए GST calculation को affect करता है!

nodes.tips: Make sure the state matches the GSTIN registration state for correct tax calculation.

explanation.en: [casual] The ZIP code.
explanation.hi: [casual] ZIP code।

explanation.en: [casual] And the country.
explanation.hi: [casual] और देश का नाम।

explanation.en: [casual] Now the shipping address! Where do deliveries actually GO? It can be the same as billing.
explanation.hi: [casual] अब shipping address! deliveries actually कहाँ जाती हैं? यह billing address जैसा भी हो सकता है।

commonQuestions.question: Is the shipping address the same as billing?
commonQuestions.answer: It can be. Many hotels use the same address for both. If deliveries go to a different entrance or location, enter that address here.

explanation.en: [casual] Line two for the shipping area.
explanation.hi: [casual] Shipping area के लिए Line two।

explanation.en: [casual] The shipping city.
explanation.hi: [casual] Shipping वाला शहर।

explanation.en: [casual] The state.
explanation.hi: [casual] State का नाम।

explanation.en: [casual] The ZIP code.
explanation.hi: [casual] ZIP code।

explanation.en: [casual] And the country.
explanation.hi: [casual] और देश का नाम।

explanation.en: [excited] Finally, the Contact Persons! These are the people you actually talk to... like the housekeeping head or procurement officer.
explanation.hi: [excited] आखिर में, Contact Persons! ये वो लोग हैं जिनसे आप actually बात करते हैं... जैसे housekeeping head या procurement officer।

explanationForMultiple.en: [friendly] Let's add a second contact so you can see how it looks.
explanationForMultiple.hi: [friendly] चलिए एक दूसरा contact add करते हैं ताकि आप देख सकें यह कैसा दिखता है।

explanation.en: [casual] Their full name.
explanation.hi: [casual] उनका पूरा नाम।

explanation.en: [casual] Their direct phone... for quick updates or issues.
explanation.hi: [casual] उनका direct phone... quick updates या किसी problem के लिए।

explanation.en: [casual] And their email. We can send them order notifications right here.
explanation.hi: [casual] और उनका email। हम उन्हें सीधे यहाँ order notifications भेज सकते हैं।

explanation.en: [curious] What's their role? Manager, procurement... this helps your team know exactly WHO to call.
explanation.hi: [curious] उनकी role क्या है? Manager, procurement... इससे आपकी team को पता चलता है कि exactly किसे call करना है।

wrapUp.en: [warm and satisfied] And that's a wrap! [chuckles] We covered basics, taxes, addresses, and contacts. Nothing was saved here... so when you're ready, go add a REAL hotel. You've got this!
wrapUp.hi: [warm and satisfied] और यह हो गया! [chuckles] हमने basics, taxes, addresses, और contacts सब cover कर लिया। यहाँ कुछ भी save नहीं हुआ... तो जब भी तैयार हों, जाइए और एक REAL hotel add करें। आप यह कर सकते हैं!

description: Walkthrough for creating a new hotel or customer
